[E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
|-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService
|   |-- contexts: WeakMap<CanvasEditingContext, CanvasHistory>
|   |   `-- object identity isolates viewers; history retained behind handle
|   |-- openContext(document, view, record?) -> frozen { contextId }
|   |   `-- new CanvasHistory(document, view, record, validation)
|   |-- state(context) -> CanvasContextState
|   |   `-- checkpointId / document / view / canUndo / canRedo
|   |-- resolve(context, diagramId) -> history.diagrams.resolve(contextId, id)
|   |-- document(context) -> history.document()             resolved document
|   |-- append(context, document, view, correspondence?) -> history.append
|   |-- navigate(context, redo?) -> history.navigate
|   |   `-- linked transfer boundary -> reject; use workspace undo/redo
|   |-- reset(context) -> history.reset
|   |-- exportContext(context) -> history.export()          CanvasHistoryRecord
|   |-- forkContext(context, view) -> history.fork(view)     CanvasHistoryRecord
|   |-- persistenceChanges(context, since?) -> history.persistenceChanges
|   |-- retireTransactions(context, ids) -> history.retireTransactions
|   |-- adopt(context, proposed) -> history.adopt
|   |-- prepareTransfer(context, input, destination?)
|   |   `-- prepareCanvasTransfer(exported source, input, exported destination?)
|   |-- transferBoundary(context, transaction, canvasId, redo?)
|   |   `-- transferBoundary({ headId }, transaction, canvasId, redo)
|   `-- prepareTransferNavigation(source, destination, transaction, redo?)
|       `-- exported histories -> { source, destination, transaction }
|-- MappingPage / transfer publication
|   |-- beginTransfer -> capture source canvasRevisionId + selectedIds
|   |-- transfer(copy | move) -> reject changed source; pause persistence
|   |   `-- runWorkspaceTask('transfer', exported histories, input)
|   |       `-- prepared source / destination document + history + view; transaction
|   |-- publishTransfer(workspace)
|   |   `-- await storage.save(workspace) -> installWorkspace(workspace)
|   |       `-- replace sessions + transfers + activeId; reset live viewState
|   `-- undo/redo at transfer boundary
|       |-- require both participants; undo newer shared transfers first
|       |-- prepareTransferNavigation -> replace both states + transaction
|       `-- save then install; new destination hidden on undo, visible on redo
|-- WorkspacePersistence / incremental path
|   |-- cursors: WeakMap<CanvasSession, sequence>
|   |-- sync(ids) <- workspace.onPersist(ids)
|   |   |-- controller.persistenceChanges(cursor) -> historyChanges(id, delta)
|   |   |-- metadata + baseline + revisions + checkpoints
|   |   |-- canvas with captured display; viewport when needed; workspace index
|   |   `-- storage.batch(changes); retain delta.sequence
|   |-- syncView(id) <- viewState.subscribe
|   |   `-- captured display + camera -> storage.batch
|   `-- deleted document -> remove prefixed records; new session -> reconcile graph
|-- WorkspaceStorage / sibling resources
|   |-- records: RecordStorage
|   |   |-- cache / pending changes / in-flight batch / sequence / revision
|   |   |-- batch -> debounce -> transport.write -> worker request('write')
|   |   |-- acknowledgement -> advance persisted sequence; clear flight
|   |   |-- failure -> retain identical in-flight batch for retry
|   |   `-- commit -> flush; definitive rejection rolls cache back
|   |-- worker: Worker                 one per opened workspace
|   |   `-- request IDs + replies      load / write / project
|   |-- load() -> workspace; worker state initializes RecordStorage
|   |-- save(snapshot) -> flush -> project(snapshot) -> records.commit(changes)
|   |-- restore() -> flush + dispose records -> load()
|   `-- flush() -> records.flush(); dispose() -> records + worker cleanup
`-- saved canvas: data only; handles and services remain runtime-only
